_about: Generated once by running Nova's TrafficMapper.Build (Manadsrapport.Core) on the synthetic inputs below; every figure is made up.
expected = Nova's report trimmed to data: no prose, no client/agency/schema/generated_at, no keywords/positions/deliverables/actions.
Chart labels converted to what the port sends: Swedish month names 'Jan'..'Dec' -> '01'..'12', 'Maj 26' -> '2026-05'.
Annotation title+text, trend text and source note -> { key, numbers, periods, dates }: the port's base id for the Swedish sentence plus every number/YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD it shows, sorted.
Nova's series keys, severities and data_status are kept as Nova wrote them; ReportMapperTests documents the deliberate differences.
